text:
Rae (PM): Dropping a compact spec note for the embedding+rerank handshake. Goal: make rerank pipelines resilient when we gate or fallback embedding models. Want quick review of acceptance criteria + edge cases. Doc: https://tiny.redwood/embed-rerank-handshake

Omar (Eng): read. main implementation concern: we often have separate calls for embed -> index -> cross-encoder. If embedding model changes due to fallback, nearest-neighbor results shift and cross-encoder input can degrade. Need binding strategy.

Lina (ML Eng): recommended binding: assign a request-level model_tag that flows across calls for a pipeline. If fallback occurs, model_tag updates and we: (a) re-run affected intermediate steps OR (b) fall back the whole pipeline to a compatible family. Tradeoffs: extra compute vs correctness.

Ike (SRE): operational constraints: avoid cascading re-runs under load. Add circuit-breaker: if fallback rate > 3% within 1m, stop autos-fallback for that tenant and route to primary queue for manual triage. Also log model_tag and fallback_reason for 30d.

Cam (Solutions): customers ask for determinism: they want either pinned pipelines or explainable fallback. Add per-customer policy `pipeline_mode` with values: `pinned` | `graceful` | `balanced`.

Rae (PM): proposed acceptance criteria:
- Consistency: pipeline-level model_tag must ensure all dependent calls use compatible model families 99.9% of the time in tests.
- Perf: single-request added latency due to binding logic <= 12ms median on hosted infra.
- Correctness: no more than 1% regression in top-k rerank recall on our eval after gating enabled.
- Resilience: circuit-breaker triggers and prevents fallback cascades; documented runbook exists.

Omar (Eng): implementation sketch:
- At router: attach `model_tag` header to request when routing decision made.
- Downstream services read header and consult compatibility table (JSON) to pick model instance.
- If downstream detects incompatible model for cached vector, it will either re-compute vector or mark cache-miss.
- Config sample:
```json
{"pipeline_mode": "graceful", "compat_table": {"embed-a": ["cross-b", "cross-c"]}}
```

Lina (ML Eng): edge cases:
- cached vectors computed with different tokenizer/quantization -> length mismatch -> cross-encoder input misaligned. Need a cache version header and mismatch detection.
- multi-tenant index sliding: index reranking quality varies by tenant data; include tenant-specific eval thresholds.

Ike (SRE): rollout plan:
- dogfood internal datasets and run synthetic rerank jobs at 10k qps in staging
- 5% canary on low-risk tenants for 48h, auto-rollback triggers: rerank recall drop >1.5% or error-rate +1%
- expand to 25% for 7d if stable

Cam (Solutions): acceptance test ask: simulate mixed pipeline with 5% of requests causing fallback mid-pipeline and verify either (re-run path) or (pinned fallback) preserves top-k recall within threshold. Add scripts to our customer test harness.

Rae (PM): open questions:
- do we expose model_tag to customers in response header? (transparency vs leaking infra detail)
- support multi-hop fallback across pipeline stages?

Omar (Eng): prefer internal-only header for now + telemetry endpoint that surfaces aggregate model transitions per tenant. Multi-hop tricky; MVP: single-step fallback + pipeline binding.

Lina (ML Eng): will prepare a 400-sample eval including cross-encoder re-ranker cases and thermalized long-context prompts to check tokenization regressions.

Ike (SRE): adding alert rules for fallback-cascade, high cache-miss due to tokenizer mismatch, and high re-run rate. Will prepare runbook.

Cam (Solutions): I'll draft the tenant policy schema and sample customer opt-in docs.

ci-bot: CI passed for branch `feat/embed-rerank-handshake`. staging preview: https://preview.redwood/embed-handshake

Rae (PM): thanks team 1 — next: Lina + Omar pair to finalize compatibility table schema Mon; Ike to run staging sweep Tue; will freeze acceptance criteria Wed. Please comment on the doc by EOD Tue. :thumbsup:
